title: Huge incoming wave
content: Earlier today I woke up from a wild dream in the usual Mallworld. Towards the end, I was outside this massive futuristic skyscraper next to the ocean with huge waves. I wanted to see the waves up close, the waves are so deep and blue as they crashed up to the beach, which there are a ton of building literally sitting right at the beach where it meets the water; I proceeded out, but then people started rushing back in, climbing as high as they could or trying to push back into the big tower we came out of; I turned around and saw a massive, MASSIVE tsunami wave coming—it looked so real. I couldn’t find the entrance I came out of, so I started climbing up the hills and cliffs around the tower with a group of others to escape the wave. It was intense! Anyone else have dreams with huge waves 🌊?
